events.title: The second edition of the Codex Justinianus takes effect
events.description: The revised Codex Justinianus, compiled on the orders of Emperor Justinian I and published in November as the Codex Repetitae Praelectionis, came into force. Its twelve books covered ecclesiastical, private, criminal and administrative law.
events.html: The revised Codex Justinianus, compiled on the orders of Emperor Justinian I and published in November as the Codex Repetitae Praelectionis, came into force. Its twelve books covered ecclesiastical, private, criminal and administrative law.

events.title: Brian Boru crushes Leinster and Dublin at Glenmama
events.description: Probably near Lyons Hill in County Kildare, the forces of Munster and Meath under Brian Boru and the High King Máel Sechnaill II crushed the armies of Leinster and Dublin led by King Máel Mórda, ending the brief Leinster revolt.
events.html: Probably near Lyons Hill in County Kildare, the forces of Munster and Meath under Brian Boru and the High King Máel Sechnaill II crushed the armies of Leinster and Dublin led by King Máel Mórda, ending the brief Leinster revolt.

events.title: A Muslim mob in Granada kills the Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela
events.description: A Muslim mob stormed the royal palace of the Taifa of Granada, killed the Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela and massacred members of the city's Jewish community.
events.html: A Muslim mob stormed the royal palace of the Taifa of Granada, killed the Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela and massacred members of the city's Jewish community.

events.title: Richard, Duke of York, is killed at Wakefield
events.description: Lancastrian forces defeated and killed Richard, Duke of York, near Wakefield. His son Edward avenged him at Towton three months later and took the throne as Edward IV.
events.html: Lancastrian forces defeated and killed Richard, Duke of York, near Wakefield. His son Edward avenged him at Towton three months later and took the throne as Edward IV.

events.title: The Gadsden Purchase treaty is signed
events.description: US minister James Gadsden signed a treaty in Mexico City buying land south of the Gila River for a railway route. It fixed the modern border of southern Arizona and New Mexico.
events.html: US minister James Gadsden signed a treaty in Mexico City buying land south of the Gila River for a railway route. It fixed the modern border of southern Arizona and New Mexico.

events.title: Grigori Rasputin is murdered in Petrograd
events.description: Nobles led by Prince Felix Yusupov killed Rasputin, the mystic whose influence over the imperial family had become a scandal (17 December, Old Style). The murder did not save the monarchy, which fell weeks later.
events.html: Nobles led by Prince Felix Yusupov killed Rasputin, the mystic whose influence over the imperial family had become a scandal (17 December, Old Style). The murder did not save the monarchy, which fell weeks later.

events.title: The Soviet Union is formally established
events.description: Delegates from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and the Transcaucasian Federation approved the treaty creating the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. It lasted until 1991.
events.html: Delegates from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and the Transcaucasian Federation approved the treaty creating the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. It lasted until 1991.

events.title: Saddam Hussein is executed in Baghdad
events.description: The former Iraqi president was hanged for crimes against humanity over the Dujail killings. A leaked mobile phone video of the jeering at his execution caused controversy.
events.html: The former Iraqi president was hanged for crimes against humanity over the Dujail killings. A leaked mobile phone video of the jeering at his execution caused controversy.
